fusions.name: Kicked-Up Clods
fusions.desc: Kicks clods of earth into the cone ahead of you, which deals 7 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Rush
fusions.desc: Thunders at an enemy up to 8 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, plus 5% of its maximum health if it is a boss or elite.

fusions.name: Second Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds, and heals you for 10 health.

fusions.name: Plodding but Endless
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 6%, and your earth resistance by 8%.
